erDiagram
    contract_templates {
        uuid id PK
        text name
        text content
        timestamp_tz created_at
        timestamp_tz updated_at
    }
    contracts {
        uuid id PK
        uuid template_id FK
        text name
        date contract_date
        numeric amount
        text content
        text pdf_path
        timestamp_tz created_at
        timestamp_tz updated_at
    }
    contract_histories {
        uuid id PK
        uuid contract_id FK
        text content
        timestamp_tz changed_at
    }
    users {
        uuid id PK
        text name
        text role
    }
    contract_approvals {
        uuid id PK
        uuid contract_id FK
        uuid user_id FK
        text status
        text comment
        timestamp_tz approved_at
    }
    contract_templates ||--o{ contracts : creates
    contracts ||--o{ contract_histories : has
    contracts ||--o{ contract_approvals : requires
    users ||--o{ contract_approvals : approves
